tasks.analysis: TechTron, a top computer manufacturing and software company, was recently brought under fire for not allowing their consumers to use competitors' web browsers on TechTron computers. This was seen as their attempt to use their dominant position in the market to keep out competitors. TechTron admitted to the accusation. However, the company explained that this was to give customers the best possible experience using their computers. Nonetheless, TechTron is now required to allow a choice of alternative, non - TechTron web browsers on their computers.
